title: Find a Pattern · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Find a Pattern · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a visible repeated pattern in the room. The lead describes the repeating elements without naming the object. The group locates the object and confirms the pattern. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Find a Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group locates the object and confirms the pattern.
recall.why: The group locates the object and confirms the pattern.
